messages.trustServerCertificateHint: Skip the certificate check for this sign-in. The connection stays encrypted.
messages.closeQueryTabWarning: The SQL in this tab will be deleted.
messages.largeResultsWarning: There’s a lot of data. Your browser may slow down.
messages.chooseResultsLimit: Show up to {limit} results at once.

errors.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to keep going.
errors.invalid_server: Enter the SQL Server IP in the Server IP field.
errors.missing_credentials: Enter your SQL Server username and password.
errors.invalid_credentials: SQL Server didn’t accept the username or password. Check both and try again.
errors.password_change_required: SQL Server needs you to change your password. Change it, then sign in again.
errors.database_unavailable: You can’t open this database. Check that it’s online and your account has access.
errors.certificate_untrusted: This app doesn’t trust the certificate from {server}. If you’re sure it’s the right server, check Trust server certificate and try again.
errors.certificate_expired: The certificate from {server} has expired. Ask whoever manages SQL Server to renew it.
errors.certificate_address_mismatch: The certificate from {server} is for a different address. Check the server IP or ask whoever manages SQL Server.
errors.certificate_invalid: This app couldn’t verify the certificate from {server}. If you’re sure it’s the right server, check Trust server certificate and try again.
errors.secure_connection_failed: Couldn’t make a secure connection to {server}. Ask whoever manages SQL Server to check its TLS settings.
errors.connection_refused: {server} refused the connection. Check the IP and port, and make sure SQL Server is running.
errors.connection_timeout: {server} took too long to answer. Check the network or VPN, then try again.
errors.connection_failed: Couldn’t reach SQL Server at {server}. Check the IP, port, and network.
errors.connection_lost: Couldn’t reach SQL Server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.sql_too_large: The SQL is too long. Run up to {limit} KB at a time.
errors.sql_invalid: Check the SQL syntax and make sure you’re running complete statements.
errors.read_only: This editor supports read-only SELECT queries and USE. Highlight those statements and try again.
errors.no_select: Add at least one SELECT statement to run.
errors.invalid_database: Choose a database from the list and try again.
errors.database_required: Choose a database before running SQL.
errors.table_not_found: SQL Server couldn’t find the table or view. Check its name and the selected database.
errors.column_not_found: SQL Server couldn’t find a column. Check the column name or alias.
errors.permission_denied: Your SQL Server account can’t run this query. Check its permissions.
errors.query_failed: SQL Server couldn’t run this query. See details for the message from SQL Server.
errors.query_timeout: The query took more than {seconds} seconds. Try a smaller query.
errors.not_found: Can’t find what you asked for. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.invalid_request: Something’s missing or looks wrong. Check the fields and try again.
errors.network_error: Can’t reach zpersist. Check your connection and try again.
